user.title: CasaDNS configuration
user.description: Configure the CasaDNS integration by entering your CasaDNS domain(s) and API-token.

error.invalid_domains: Please enter one or more valid CasaDNS subdomains only, for example home or home.camera. Do not enter a full domain name.
error.invalid_token: Please enter a valid API token.
error.invalid_interval: Interval must be 15 minutes or higher.

init.title: CasaDNS options
init.description: Adjust the domain(s) and update interval used by the CasaDNS integration.

error.invalid_domains: Please enter at least one valid domain (comma-separated, without .casadns.eu).

update_now.name: Force CasaDNS update
update_now.description: Force CasaDNS to check the current public IP address and update the configured DNS records. When response data is requested, the current CasaDNS status is returned.
